note: What a captured kernel is, by words in the name a capture tool reports; for labels and the pairing walk's landmarks only, never for attribution. Read only through collectors/kernel_kind.py. ORDER MATTERS: kind_of takes the first row of `words` whose word is in the name, then the first row of `prefixes` the name starts with, else `other`. A name that says what it is comes before a library's name, and the GEMV words before the elementwise ones. The GEMV words are the rows of kind `unattributed`. An engine that renames a kernel changes this table: the engine-upgrade audit reviews the classification diff before a pin moves (docs/engine-upgrade-audit.md).

words.why: Mamba's and the gated delta net's scan and conv kernels (ssm_conv, ssm_scan)
TensorRT-LLM's _selective_scan_update_kernel is Mamba's recurrent scan (Nemotron 3.5 on an H200, 2026-11-09)
before flash: flashinfer::norm::RMSNormKernel is a norm, not attention (Nemotron 3.5 on an H200, 2026-11-09)

cuBLAS/cuBLASLt's split-K reduction after a splitK GEMM. This row and the helper rows after it carry no model weight: the pairing walk reads them as no projection slot (Nemotron 3.5 TensorRT-LLM on an H200, 2026-11-09)
torch's sort (topk's bitonicSortKVInPlace) and an MoE dispatch's expert map build (TensorRT-LLM's fusedBuildExpertMapsSortFirstToken)
torch's elementwise_kernel family (vectorized/unrolled, index, scatter/gather, fills, compares, arange)
an MoE dispatch's gather of each expert's rows
an MoE grouped GEMM's stride table
a fast Walsh-Hadamard transform rotates activations and reads no weights

a GEMV no role took: weight time outside the limit, and the capture has no bytes for it. The GEMV words come before the elementwise ones: mul_mat_vec holds mul, and a 2 ms GEMV is not elementwise work
